source_metadata.title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations

extraction_limitations: Atoms were extracted from the uploaded preprint PDF using parsed text plus targeted inspection of rendered pages; they have not been independently human-verified.
Extraction prioritizes original study objectives, methods, empirical results, limitations, conclusions, and reproducibility statements; cited background literature was not atomized.
Appendix material was selectively atomized when it materially changed interpretation of the main retrieval, conversion, benchmark, or dense-sweep claims.
No funding-disclosure or conflict-of-interest atom was created because the accessible paper text did not contain an explicit funding or conflict statement to encode.
SourceSection lacks a dedicated limitations/appendix enum; limitation anchors use section=other and appendix anchors use section=supplement as the closest schema-supported representation.
